questions.prompt: 1 of 3 · The quiet tablemate — Several students have contributed little. The group is about to move on.
questions.explanation: A broad invitation encourages participation without putting one person on the spot.

options.text: “Before we move on, are there any additional perspectives?”

questions.prompt: 2 of 3 · The detour — The transportation discussion has drifted into a long debate about lunch menus.
questions.explanation: Respectfully return to the task and offer a way forward.

options.text: “That has nothing to do with anything.”
“Could we return to the transportation barriers our plan needs to address?”

questions.prompt: 3 of 3 · The clock — Limited time remains, and the proposed plan is unfinished.
questions.explanation: Time management helps the group finish without taking over its decisions.

options.text: “Could we prioritize recommendations and reserve time to review the plan?”
